title: First hypnotic regression: tall being working on him
place_text: aboard craft near November 5, South Dakota

tellings.quote: Pleasant and these these were the the one that was messing with me was a very tall one

plain: Mario Woods, a former nuclear missile guard who says he was taken aboard a craft near a South Dakota missile site called November 5 in 1977, describes his first hypnotic regression, a session where hypnosis is used to try to bring back lost memories, which involved a man named Bob Upton. He says he recalled beings around him and that "the one that was messing with me was a very tall one." He tells it as his own memory, which if true would fill in what happened during the hours he says he lost.
